title: common
description: Shared definitions referenced by other contracts through $ref; the document itself is an empty object.

module_id.description: Module id: equals the folder name and the import package name.

relpath.description: Relative POSIX path without leading slash, without empty segments and without . or .. segments.

sha256_prefixed.description: SHA-256 digest written as sha256:<64 lower-case hex digits>.

version_dir.description: Contract major version directory such as v1 (no v0, no leading zeros).

extensions.description: Extension values keyed by <owner>.<name>; the owner validates its own keys, others ignore them.

^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*\\.[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*$.description: Value owned by the namespace owner.

rfc3339_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z.
